title: Concept: pyproject dependency with no version constraint
description: pyproject.toml declares a dependency string that names only the package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build takes whatever the index serves, so a release published after review installs with no change to the file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: The build takes whatever the index serves, so a release published after review installs with no change to the file.
